text:
alex_ryan: Heads-up — spotted steady mem growth (~200MB/hr) on runtime canary serving streaming chat + tool loops. Repro on dedicated-us-west-2-3 with guppy-8k-q4a; only when sessions exceed ~1200 tokens.

maria_g: which canary and workload? region?

alex_ryan: canary=dedicated-us-west-2-3, workload=toolchain-runner streaming chat that calls ~3 tools per turn. Growth only on long sessions (-> tool loop churn). No immediate OOMs.

samir: did anything touch kernel selection / batching recently? we merged the adaptive-kernel-chooser + batching refactor last week.

perf-bot: Collected heap snapshot at 3623456790 and periodic KV residency logs.

alex_ryan: Heap/top allocs show stable CPU allocations but a steady increase in KV-resident pages and slab usage. Eviction counts are low despite pressure. Suspect pinned refs or missed release path.

maria_g: can you paste KV counters (resident, evicted, holdcounts, fragmentation)?

alex_ryan: sample below from canary (trimmed):
```
kv_resident_pages: 12456
kv_evicted_pages: 432
kv_hold_count_hist: {0: 98.0%, 1: 1.5%, 2+: 0.5%}
kv_page_fragmentation: 12.3%
largest_free_run: 64KB
per_session_avg_residency: 42 pages
```

samir: evicted_pages looks too low relative to resident_pages under that workload. If hold_count doesn't drop to 0 after session end, pages stay pinned. Any long-lived iterators or 'cache view' objects?

lee: I ran a small reproducer locally: `./stress_toolchain --session-len 1500 --streaming=true --rate 10` — VM RSS climbs steadily.

alex_ryan: repro steps nailed. Also saw pmap/VmSize creeping between samples; no kernel OOM.

maria_g: try toggling the feature flag kv_release_on_finalize to force release on session finalize, see if growth stops.

alex_ryan: flipped kv_release_on_finalize=true on canary at 3623456802. Growth stopped (observed ~30m post-change). Suggests missing release during finalize/error path. :eyes:

samir: that aligns with the batching refactor (commit 9c3aabf) which introduced a per-request cache view object and early-return on errors. I suspect we didn't call cache_view->release() on the error path. Quick diff:
```
- if (err) return err;
+ if (err) { cache_view->release(); return err; }
```

alex_ryan: opened PR to add missing release and a unit test that simulates tool loop error path. PR: https://sc.redwood/pr/8812

perf-bot: Quick smoke after PR deploy (canary): 30m run, growth rate dropped to <5MB/hr.

maria_g: good. Next steps: 1) merge hotfix, 2) add assert in long-session CI to check holdcount==0 after session finalize, 3) run overnight longtool-run (4h) on staging.

samir: also audit other early-return/error paths in batching and kernel-selection code. We should ensure cache view lifetimes are tied to a single RAII wrapper where possible.

lee: adding TODO in backlog: move cache_view to unique_ptr-like RAII (tickets: PERF-1294).

alex_ryan: I'll schedule overnight run and post follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
